title: perf(console): keep the chat UI out of the first page load via @object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core (objectui#13410)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuW9izc3zH47co5esYgQstYc)_

Fixes #13410
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The Console's first page load no longer downloads the chat UI. The eager closure drops by **254,055 gzipped bytes** (3,326,111 → 3,072,056), and `plugin-chatbot-*` is no longer an eagerly loaded chunk.

## Why it was eager

Four static paths, each enough on its own to keep the whole `plugin-chatbot` chunk group in every first load:

1. `app-shell` imported small helpers (`useAgents`, the agent alias helpers, `AI_USAGE_REFRESH_EVENT`, `publishHealthFromResponse`, `detectPendingApproval`) from the package root in 13 eager modules. The root does `export * from './renderer'`, which registers the chat components at module scope.
2. `ConsoleLayout` → `ChatDock` imported `ChatPane` (and with it `AiChatPage`) statically.
3. `App.tsx` imported `DefaultAiChatPage` statically.
4. `App.tsx` imported `SharedRecordPage` (`/s/:token`, renders `ChatbotEnhanced`) statically.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`**: new subpath export `./core` (`src/core.ts`), side-effect-free: it re-exports only the hooks and parsers above and their types. The two helpers that lived inside chat UI modules move to `publishHealth.ts` and `aiUsageEvents.ts`; `ChatbotEnhanced` and `useObjectChat` re-export them unchanged. `dist/core.js` (5.3 KB, imports only `react`) comes from a second build pass, `vite.core.config.ts`, because the main pass emits UMD and a multi-entry lib build cannot. `dist/core.d.ts` comes from the main pass's `dts` plugin. The existing `"."` export entry is untouched; `"./core"` is added beside it.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: every import of those names goes through `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`, including `AiChatPage`'s (it keeps the root for the chat UI it renders). The ChatDock's default body moves to `layout/ChatDockConversation.tsx` and loads through `lazy()`; `resolveApiBase` moves to `console/ai/resolveApiBase.ts` and is re-exported from `AiChatPage` unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/console`**:
  - `/ai…` loads through the console-local module `components/aiChatPage.ts`, on the `components/studioBuilder.ts` pattern. `/s/:token` loads lazily too.
  - `registerChatbotComponents.ts` registers `chatbot`, `chatbot-enhanced` and `chatbot-floating` as lazy stubs. They used to be registered only as a side effect of path 1. It is deliberately not in `register-plugins.ts`, so the shipped `sdui.manifest.json` is unchanged. Those three types were never in it, and adding them would change what the host's save door accepts.
  - `vite.config.ts` gets the `/core` alias and a `plugin-chatbot-core` chunk group with `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`, so the core modules are not co-tenants of the chat chunk.
- **Gate**: `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3,834,000 → 3,579,945, down by exactly the measured drop, and `BASELINE` moves to the `b6f11d3` reading. Left in place, the ceiling sat 744.1 KB over the new reading, and the sensitivity half called it blind (exit 2) on the branch build. Headroom stays 507,889 bytes (0.71x the regression), the same as `main` had. Per-chunk rows are unchanged. Two test literals follow the new rendering (`3049.3` → `3000.1`).
- **Tests**: mocks of the moved names now target `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core` (33 files, mechanical: a root mock whose only overrides were core names is retargeted, and a mixed one has its `useAgents` override moved into a `/core` mock). `ChatDock.partialRuntimeConfig` awaits the lazy body.

## Measurement

One container, one instrument: `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` in `apps/console`, reading `dist/eager-closure.json`. Control `7981384` (`main`, separate worktree) against `b6f11d3` (control + this PR's source). Gzipped bytes:

| chunk | `7981384` | `b6f11d3` | delta |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `plugin-chatbot` | 173,666 | — | −173,666 |
| `vendor-markdown` | 102,901 | 13,351 | −89,550 |
| `vendor-react-markdown` | 1,146 | 23,928 | +22,782 |
| `ui-components` | 296,133 | 308,400 | +12,267 |
| `plugin-chatbot-core` (new) | — | 5,735 | +5,735 |
| everything else | 1,006,784 | 975,161 | −31,623 |
| **aggregate** | **3,326,111** (78 of 2262) | **3,072,056** (85 of 2291) | **−254,055** |

`vendor-objectstack`, `framework` and `i18n-locale-en` are byte-identical. "Everything else" is the `/ai` page and what only it and the dock body reach (`AiChatPage`, `useChatConversation`, `ConversationsSidebar`, `BuildDebugDrawer`, …) plus `SharedRecordPage`. It was read module by module from `dist/stats.html` of a non-`CI` build of each tree, which wrote the same totals to the byte.

**`vendor-markdown` (the card's optional question): mostly yes.** 89.5 KB of it leaves. About 35 KB of the markdown family stays eager, on other lines: `MarkdownContent` in `packages/fields` (the objectui#5325 co-tenant of the eager `ui-components` chunk) reaches the `remark-gfm` family. Those modules lost the `$initial` reach `vendor-markdown`'s tag claims by, so `vendor-react-markdown` (+22,782) and `ui-components` (+12,267, 60 modules) capture them. They were eager before and are eager after, so they add no first-load bytes. `ui-components` stays under its ceiling (301.2 / 338.9 KB).

## Accepted deviations

- **Done-when bullet 1 ("no non-test app-shell file imports the package root")** is met for every helper import. Two files still import the root for the chat UI itself, which `/core` must not carry: `AiChatPage.tsx` (`ChatbotEnhanced`, `useObjectChat`, …) and, through it, `ChatDockConversation.tsx`. Both are reached only through `lazy()`, which is the "behind the chat surface's own dynamic import" route of bullet 2. The build confirms it: no eager chunk holds a `packages/plugin-chatbot` module outside `plugin-chatbot-core`.
- **No `sideEffects` field** on `plugin-chatbot`'s `package.json`. The fix does not depend on it, and a list that missed one side-effectful module would silently drop it from a consumer's bundle.
- **No new guard.** The reverted tree (`7981384`) still passes under the lowered aggregate line, because 254,055 is inside the 695 KiB band the objectui#12653 ruling accepted. A regression would show as `plugin-chatbot` in `Bundle Analysis`'s largest-chunks list. Per the startup-stage rule, a new gate needs a maintainer's call, so I did not add one. The budget docblock says so.

## Verification (on `b6f11d3` / branch tip)

| command | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/app-shell/src/{layout,hooks,console/ai,console/home,views/studio-design,preview,views/metadata-admin/previews} apps/console/src/pages/system` | `Test Files 777 passed`, after the one remaining file (`ChatDock.partialRuntimeConfig`) was fixed and re-run: 4/4 |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts scripts/__tests__/render-budget-comment.test.ts` | 305/305 |
| `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/plugin-chatbot --filter=@object-ui/console` | 38/38 tasks, includes the new `plugin-chatbot` build (`dist/core.js`, `dist/core.d.ts`) |
| `pnpm check:eager-closure` on the branch build | exit 0, aggregate 3000.1 / 3496.0 KB (0.71x), membership exact |
| `pnpm check:{phantom-deps,unused-deps,self-import,dist-completeness,esm-specifiers,node-esm-load,published-dist,published-tsconfig-exclude,registry-bare-names,side-effects-array,sdui-registration-pins,docs-route-closure,entry-guard,test-path-roots,vi-mock-specifiers,vi-mock-inherit,vi-mock-override-shape,readme-exports,unreferenced-sources,changeset-claims,pending-changeset-literals,installed-pin-claims,new-line-citations,control-bytes}` | all exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec eslint` on the changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files | 0 errors (90 existing warnings, none new in kind) |

NOT RUN locally: the full repo test suite, Playwright E2E, and a live browser run of the dock and `/ai` against a server. CI covers the first two.

## Acceptance notes

- The objectui#5325 co-tenancy (`MarkdownContent` in eager `ui-components`, reached only through `React.lazy`) now holds the ~35 KB of markdown modules that are still eager. It is already on the ledger in `scripts/vite-ineffective-dynamic-imports.ts`. Not filed again.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
